2026-10-15.content:
Released Apigee Edge for Private Cloud 4.54.00.

Designated Apigee Edge for Private Cloud 4.54.00.00 a long-term support (LTS)
release: 18 months of full support ending April 2028, then 18 months of
maintenance ending October 2029. After October 2029, 4.54.00.00 receives no
software updates, security mitigations, or technical support.

Installing a later 4.54 minor release or patch does not change those dates. To
extend the support lifecycle, upgrade to the next LTS release.

For the support lifecycle phases, release cadences, and version numbering, see
[Apigee Edge for Private Cloud release and lifecycle policy](https://docs.apigee.com/release/private-cloud-release-lifecycle-policy).

summary.title: New Apigee Edge for Private Cloud Release
summary.summary: Apigee Edge for Private Cloud 4.54.00 is now available as a long-term support (LTS) release. This version offers extended support until October 2029, with full support ending in April 2028. To access future updates and maintain support, consider upgrading to subsequent LTS releases.

2026-10-15.content:
This release replaces Java 8 with Java 17 and Java 21, removes the Classic UI
and the `apigee-sso` component, and updates the bundled Cassandra, Postgres,
OpenLDAP, ZooKeeper, Qpid Broker-J, Nginx, and Consul versions. These changes
are not backward-compatible.

For the 4.54.00 versions and the 4.53.01 versions they replace, see
[Supported software and supported versions](https://docs.apigee.com/release/supported-software).

Before upgrading, read
[Changes in Edge for Private Cloud 4.54.00](https://docs.apigee.com/private-cloud/v4.54.00/changes-privatecloud-45400),
then
[Update Apigee Edge 4.53.00 or 4.53.01 to 4.54.00](https://docs.apigee.com/private-cloud/v4.54.00/update-apigee-edge-4530x-45400)
or
[New installation overview](https://docs.apigee.com/private-cloud/v4.54.00/installation-overview).
For known issues, see
[Known issues with Edge for Private Cloud](https://docs.apigee.com/release/known-issues#private-cloud-known-issues).

summary.title: Edge for Private Cloud 4.54.00 Release Notes
summary.summary: This release introduces significant updates, including the replacement of Java 8 with Java 17 and Java 21, and the removal of the Classic UI and apigee-sso component. These non-backward-compatible changes affect bundled software versions and require careful review of the provided upgrade and installation guides before proceeding.

2026-10-15.content:
Replaced the Classic UI (`edge-ui`) with the
[New Edge UI](https://docs.apigee.com/private-cloud/v4.54.00/new-edge-ui)
(`edge-management-ui`).

The New Edge UI is the only management UI in 4.54.00 and is installed by
default. Deployments running the Classic UI must transition to it before
upgrading. Custom Classic UI properties do not carry over automatically. The
default port also changes from `9000` to `3001`, configurable with
`conf_uebe_port`, so firewall rules and load balancer target ports that point
at `9000` fail until they are updated.

For the migration steps and the supported feature list, see
[Migrate to the New Edge UI](https://docs.apigee.com/private-cloud/v4.54.00/migrate-ui)
and
[What features are supported?](https://docs.apigee.com/private-cloud/v4.54.00/new-edge-ui#features).

summary.title: New UI Replaces Classic UI
summary.summary: The Classic UI has been replaced by the New Edge UI in version 4.54.00. This new UI is installed by default and is the only management UI available. Deployments using the Classic UI must migrate before upgrading. Ensure firewall rules and load balancer configurations are updated to reflect the new default port of 3001.

2026-10-15.content:
In deployments with Apigee SSO enabled, an integrated OIDC identity broker in
`apigee-openldap` replaces the standalone `apigee-sso` component and Apache
Tomcat 9.0.x. Before upgrading, take a complete and validated LDAP backup;
existing `apigee-sso` configurations do not migrate automatically. Deployments
not using Apigee SSO require no action.

For migration prerequisites, validation checks, and rollback constraints, see
[Option 2: Upgrade UI (with Apigee SSO)](https://docs.apigee.com/private-cloud/v4.54.00/update-apigee-edge-4530x-45400#upgrade-ui-with-apigee-sso).

summary.title: Apigee SSO Update
summary.summary: Apigee SSO component is updated with an integrated OIDC identity broker. Back up your LDAP before upgrading, as existing configurations won't migrate automatically. Deployments not using Apigee SSO are unaffected.

2026-10-15.content:
4.54.00 runs Java in mixed mode: Java 17 for Cassandra and ZooKeeper, Java 21
for the Management Server, Message Processor, Router, and Qpid Broker-J. Both
Oracle JDK and OpenJDK are supported at those versions.

Oracle JDK 8 and OpenJDK 8 are no longer supported.

API proxies with custom JavaCallout policies or custom resource JARs can break
on Java 21. For details, see
[Changes in Edge for Private Cloud 4.54.00](https://docs.apigee.com/private-cloud/v4.54.00/changes-privatecloud-45400).

summary.title: Java runtime updated
summary.summary: Apigee 4.54.00 now uses Java 17 and Java 21 for various components, with support for both Oracle JDK and OpenJDK. Older Java 8 versions are no longer supported, and API proxies with custom Java callouts may require updates for Java 21 compatibility.

2026-10-15.content:
Upgraded Nginx on the Edge Router to 1.30.0.

If you are upgrading from Nginx 1.20.x, see
[Nginx 1.30 changes in Apigee Edge 4.54.00](https://docs.apigee.com/private-cloud/v4.54.00/nginx-45400)
for the full list of changes.

summary.title: Nginx Edge Router Updated
summary.summary: The Nginx on the Edge Router has been upgraded to version 1.30.0. For detailed information on changes, especially if upgrading from Nginx 1.20.x, please refer to the official documentation.

2026-10-15.content:
Changed the TLS defaults on Message Processors to the Java 21 cryptographic
baseline.

Message Processors run on Java 21, which enables TLS 1.3 by default
([JEP 332](https://openjdk.org/jeps/332)) and prefers it for outbound backend
connections, falling back to TLS 1.2. No configuration change is required if
your target servers and load balancers negotiate TLS 1.3, or negotiate TLS 1.2
with forward-secret (ECDHE) cipher suites.

Java 21 also disables the non-forward-secret static RSA key-exchange suites
(`TLS_RSA_*`). If you have overridden
`conf_http_HTTPTransport.ssl.cipher.suites.whitelist` or
`conf_message-processor-communication_local.http.ssl.ciphers` with static RSA
suites only, backend calls fail with `no cipher suites in common` and the
Router cannot complete a TLS handshake with the Message Processor. Replace the
`TLS_RSA_*` entries with modern cipher suites and restart the Message
Processor.

For the remediation path, see
[Legacy backend requirements and remediation](https://docs.apigee.com/private-cloud/v4.54.00/changes-privatecloud-45400#legacy-tls-remediation).

summary.title: Updated TLS defaults for Message Processors
summary.summary: Message Processors now use the Java 21 cryptographic baseline, enabling TLS 1.3 by default for outbound connections. While no configuration changes are needed for most users, ensure your backend servers support TLS 1.3 or TLS 1.2 with forward secrecy. If you've customized cipher suites, update them to avoid connection issues.

2026-10-15.content:
Added Basic authentication to the New Edge UI, which lets you sign in without
configuring an identity provider.

The [New Edge UI](https://docs.apigee.com/private-cloud/v4.54.00/new-edge-ui)
supports Basic authentication without additional configuration. You can also
configure Apigee SSO, or an external identity provider such as SAML or OIDC.
This feature is generally available in 4.54.00.

summary.title: Basic Authentication for New Edge UI
summary.summary: The New Edge UI now supports Basic authentication, allowing you to sign in without configuring an identity provider. This feature is generally available in version 4.54.00.

2026-10-15.content:
Added automated pre-flight validation checks to `apigee-setup` and
`apigee-service`, which surface environment configuration problems before a
component is installed.

This feature is generally available in 4.54.00.

summary.title: Automated pre-flight validation checks
summary.summary: Automated pre-flight validation checks have been added to apigee-setup and apigee-service. This feature surfaces environment configuration problems before component installation and is generally available in version 4.54.00.

2026-10-15.content:
Fixed multiple security vulnerabilities in Apigee Edge for Private Cloud
4.54.00.

These fixes ship as part of the component upgrades in this release; see
[Changes in Edge for Private Cloud 4.54.00](https://docs.apigee.com/private-cloud/v4.54.00/changes-privatecloud-45400).

summary.title: Security fixes in Apigee Edge
summary.summary: Multiple security vulnerabilities in Apigee Edge for Private Cloud 4.54.00 have been resolved. These updates are included in the component upgrades for this release. More details can be found in the release notes.

2026-10-15.content:
Changed the default garbage collector on Message Processors to the
Garbage-First garbage collector.

Message Processors set `useG1GC=true` and `useStringDeduplication=true` by
default in 4.54.00. In 4.53.01 neither was set by default. To configure garbage
collection, see
[Configure the garbage collector for Message Processors](https://docs.apigee.com/private-cloud/v4.54.00/configuring-gc-message-processors-4.54).

summary.title: Default garbage collector changed
summary.summary: The default garbage collector for Message Processors has been updated to Garbage-First (G1GC). This change, effective from version 4.54.00, also enables string deduplication by default. For detailed configuration, refer to the Apigee documentation.

2026-09-02.content:
Apigee Edge for Private Cloud release notes are now published on Google Cloud
documentation.

Release notes and patch announcements for Apigee Edge for Private Cloud are
published on the
[Apigee Edge for Private Cloud release notes](https://docs.cloud.google.com/apigee/docs/edge-private-cloud/release-notes)
page from September 2026 onward. You can
[subscribe](https://docs.cloud.google.com/apigee/docs/edge-private-cloud/release-notes#sub) to that page with
a feed reader to be notified when a new release or patch is published.

Release notes published before September 2026 remain available in the
[Apigee Edge release notes archive](https://docs.apigee.com/release/notes/apigee-release-notes).

summary.title: Apigee Edge Private Cloud Release Notes Now Available
summary.summary: Release notes and patch announcements for Apigee Edge for Private Cloud are now published on the Google Cloud documentation site starting September 2026. Older release notes are available in the Apigee Edge release notes archive.
